title: macOS: fix focus update when using search or command palette
body:
This fixes two things:

1. Surface focus state is not consistent with first responder state when the search bar is open.
  > Reproduce: Open search, switch to another app and back, observe the cursor state of the surface.
  > And after switching back, `cmd+shift+f` will close the search bar, surface will become focused but not first responder, so it will not accept any input
2. Command palette is not focused when built with Xcode 26.4 (26.3 works fine).
  > This is weird to me, because the tip (and built with 26.3) works fine. I guess it's related to the SDK update? I couldn’t be sure what went wrong, but dispatching it to the next loop works as previously.
  > Also cleaned some previous checks when quickly open and reopen.
  > This fix works great both with 26.4 and 26.3
